description: This CSS file defines the styles and theme management for the 'App' component of the meal planner frontend, including light and dark theme colors, layout, and responsive design rules.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main container for the meal planner application, styled with light and dark theme support.

classes.name: App-header
classes.description: Header section of the App, styled to center content with background color transitions.

classes.name: App-logo
classes.description: Logo element with animations and responsive sizing.

classes.name: App-link
classes.description: Defines the styling for links in the application with a focus on theme colors.

classes.name: theme-toggle
classes.description: Button for toggling between light and dark themes with hover effects.
